LOOM EXPLAIN -- R3 normalize 5.1 AV oneshot
=========================================
manifest sha256: 28b4d87d4ae62a7abc8c32b3e14cf1ddaa8b9f0b6b11c3fdbe3c59c22e5c1406
1 source(s) | 1 target(s) | 12 plan step(s)

SOURCES  (file facts are probed, never typed -- ADR-5)
  main: wavs/main.wav
    declared: kind bed, layout 5.1, order bs2051
    probed:   6 ch, 48000 Hz, 24-bit, 4800 frames, sha256 8d4b7cb45d30

POLICY  (as resolved)
  codec: opus  (coupled 128000 bps, uncoupled 64000 bps)
  loudness: measure -- embedded loudness values are measured at
    execution on rendered layouts (BS.1770), never typed
  normalize: -14 LUFS -- gain-ride the source, then re-measure the ridden
    audio; accept within +/-0.3 LU; clip guard: ridden digital peak must stay
    below -0.05 dBFS (Loom is not a limiter)
  profile: auto -- derived per target from element/channel arithmetic
  validate: fail_on_error -- every output passes through the Sentinel gate at
    run time (L3 rendered QC when oracles are present); findings S-320/S-321
    escalate to run-failing on Loom-packaged outputs

TARGET 1/1: dist/norm51.mp4
  format: mp4   profile: simple   backend: ffmpeg_oneshot + ffmpeg mux
  why this route:
    Opus A/V one-shot from WAV: the ADR-1 designated FFmpeg use (encode+mux in
    one invocation, ADR-2); two-pass BS.1770 measure->inject applied (F7
    closed); F4 order and F6 streamids compiler-enforced
  steps (execution order):
     1. s00-stage-src  [stage_input, internal]
        from $SRCDIR/wavs/main.wav; to $WORK/wav/main.wav
        why: single input_wav_directory for encoder_main; staged copy pins the
          bytes the plan's source hash refers to
     2. t00-norm51-enc-pre  [encode, ffmpeg]
        writes $WORK/norm/t00-norm51/pre.iamf
        why: R3 pass-A encode (FFmpeg one-shot audio path); never a
          deliverable
     3. t00-norm51-render-anchor-pre  [render, decoder_main]
        writes $WORK/norm/t00-norm51/anchor-pre.wav
        why: R3: reference-render the anchor layout (stereo — the first
          effective loudness layout) pre-ride
     4. t00-norm51-measure-anchor-pre  [measure_bs1770, sentinel-dsp]
        why: R3: pre-ride BS.1770-4 on the anchor render (sentinel-dsp kernel
          — conformant engine, F34); the ride gain derives from THIS
          measurement only
     5. t00-norm51-ride  [gain_ride, ffmpeg]
        writes $WORK/wavn/t00-norm51/main.wav
        resolves at execution: ${gain:t00-norm51-measure-anchor-pre:-14.00}
        why: R3 gain-ride to -14 LUFS (gain = target - measured, resolved at
          execution; clip guard: ridden digital peak must stay below -0.05
          dBFS — Loom is not a limiter)
     6. t00-norm51-p1  [encode, ffmpeg]
        writes $WORK/os/t00-norm51.pass1.iamf
        why: pass 1 of the two-pass loudness flow; never a deliverable (FFmpeg
          alone writes 0.0 loudness, F7) — reads the ridden WAV (R3), so these
          measurements are the post-ride truth
     7. t00-norm51-render-stereo  [render, decoder_main]
        writes $WORK/os/t00-norm51.stereo.wav
        why: reference-render the stereo loudness layout for BS.1770
          measurement
     8. t00-norm51-measure-stereo  [measure_bs1770, sentinel-dsp]
        why: BS.1770-4 via the sentinel-dsp kernel (F34: the declared values
          must be conformant; ebur128's BACK_MASK is F29-non-conformant on
          7.1.x); computed, never typed
     9. t00-norm51-render-5_1  [render, decoder_main]
        writes $WORK/os/t00-norm51.5_1.wav
        why: reference-render the 5.1 loudness layout for BS.1770 measurement
    10. t00-norm51-measure-5_1  [measure_bs1770, sentinel-dsp]
        why: BS.1770-4 via the sentinel-dsp kernel (F34: the declared values
          must be conformant; ebur128's BACK_MASK is F29-non-conformant on
          7.1.x); computed, never typed
    11. t00-norm51-p2  [encode, ffmpeg]
        writes $OUTDIR/dist/norm51.mp4
        resolves at execution: ${measure:t00-norm51-measure-stereo:il},
          ${measure:t00-norm51-measure-stereo:dp},
          ${measure:t00-norm51-measure-stereo:tp},
          ${measure:t00-norm51-measure-5_1:il},
          ${measure:t00-norm51-measure-5_1:dp},
          ${measure:t00-norm51-measure-5_1:tp}
        why: Opus A/V one-shot from WAV: the ADR-1 designated FFmpeg use
          (encode+mux in one invocation, ADR-2); two-pass BS.1770
          measure->inject applied (F7 closed); F4 order and F6 streamids
          compiler-enforced
    12. t00-norm51-verify  [verify_loudness, internal]
        why: R3 accept: the re-measured (and injected) anchor-layout loudness
          of the ridden program must land within ±0.3 LU of the normalize
          target

NOTES
  $TOOLCHAIN / $WORK / $OUTDIR / $SRCDIR are execution-time roots; plans are
    environment-portable and contain no absolute paths.
  ${measure:...} / ${gain:...} tokens are data-dependent plan edges: their
    values come from BS.1770-4 measurements made during execution (computed,
    never typed -- ADR-5).
